disposition_reason: The paper reports an ordered waveform-only tracking validation endpoint and its numeric result. The existing five-mouse/two-day demo and v2 native runtime are a reduced, differently defined comparison, not the original 16-mouse cross-day endpoint; full original data, paper-era code equivalence and scientific admission remain incomplete.

source_paper.title: Tracking neurons across days with high-density probes

evidence.locator: Results: Validation with stable functional properties, Fig.4; Methods: ROC and AUC; Data availability
evidence.supports: Original cross-day ISI AUC, animal-level aggregation, eligible recordings and limited public data coverage.
The demo comprises IDs1-5 and two consecutive recordings per mouse; this is not the full 16-mouse result population.
Waveform inputs, unit identity metadata, independent functional validation and author pipeline route.

evidence.locator: functional score preparation and ISI calculations
evidence.supports: Current author functional validation implementation; does not establish paper-era equivalence.
Registered runtime explicitly calls the five-mouse endpoint a functional proxy and uses official v2.0 with a benchmark-specific decoder.

target.description: Track putative identical neurons across recordings from spike waveforms; evaluate cross-day match versus nonmatch separation using independent ISI fingerprints. AUC measures functional consistency, not ground-truth identity accuracy.

dataset.description: Original chronic Neuropixels study recordings supporting Fig. 4. Public demo24305758v1 covers IDs1-5; full datasets for IDs1,7,8 are linked in24411841v1, and remaining full recordings are available only on request. The complete Fig. 4 input release is not recovered.

cohort.description: The published cross-day ISI summary uses16 mice. Exact eligible session/location/pair membership must be restored; five mice with two consecutive recordings cannot replace this population.

split.description: Within-recording split-half waveforms calibrate matching; functional validation evaluates original across-day recording pairs. There is no original leave-one-mouse-out improvement split. A new held-mouse fold remains an extension.

inputs.description: Average waveforms at recording sites, position and original unit/session metadata. Functional ISI, population coupling and sensory responses are evaluation information, excluded from matching and candidate selection on final recordings.

preprocessing.description: Preserve independently spike-sorted units, author waveform processing/drift correction, good-unit criteria and the paper-era default matching algorithm. Current pinned functional code and the registered v2/greedy decoder have not been reconciled to the publication version.

metric.description: ROC AUC separating ISI-histogram correlations of matches from nonmatches; use original exclusions and require at least 20 matched units per eligible recording comparison. Within-recording matched units are excluded.

aggregation.description: Retain original recording/location summaries within each mouse and then the16-mouse mean with animal-level uncertainty. Match counts, eligible support and pair/day coverage must be retained; neurons and directed pair entries are not independent replicates.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Fig. 4 cross-day ISI-fingerprint AUC, full 16-mouse population

published_baseline.description: Published mean 0.88 with SEM 0.01 across 16 mice; the within-day 0.94 and example-pair 0.95 are different conditions. This number is not the baseline for the five-mouse demo.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No original-cohort author rerun is established. Recover the paper-era source, full data and original eligible pair roster before comparing; a v2 five-mouse rerun is separate calibration.

minimum_effect.rationale: A task-specific AUC gain must exceed rerun variability while preserving match yield, all original support and validation independence. No justified magnitude has yet been recovered; strict improvement alone is insufficient.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired animal-level comparison on original per-mouse endpoints, retaining nested recording/location/day structure; choose interval and decision rule after original variability is recovered, before candidate selection.
uncertainty.independent_unit: mouse; dependent recordings, units and directed pairs remain grouped
uncertainty.rationale: The paper performs statistics across animals. Source SEM is not candidate-versus-baseline uncertainty; functional stability is also a biological assumption.

paper_win_requires: Restore and evaluate every original eligible16-mouse recording/location/day comparison using paper-equivalent matching and fingerprint construction.
Reproduce 0.88 under the original aggregation with a declared calibration tolerance; compare against both the published result and a competent author rerun.
Demonstrate the predeclared meaningful AUC gain with animal-level uncertainty while preserving matched-unit yield and eligible support; do not improve AUC by selecting fewer easy matches.
Do not count a five-mouse demo gain, new held-mouse split, changed code version, human-curation agreement or increased match count alone as surpassing the paper.

current_sota.description: The source-paper comparison is separate from present-day SOTA; no current leaderboard or later-method superiority is asserted.

episode.improvement_loop: After source recovery, iterate waveform-only algorithms on permitted development recordings with final functional targets inaccessible. Freeze any use of development functional information explicitly; it cannot be assumed equivalent to source unsupervised calibration.
episode.candidate_freeze: Seal waveform feature definitions, matching policy, preprocessing, source revision, exclusions and all selection choices before final original-cohort functional evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Run candidate and paper-equivalent native reference on identical full original recordings; keep the legacy five-mouse paired report separately labeled. Compare paired animal endpoints only after full support and provenance admission.
episode.baseline_policy: Published16-mouse AUC, paper-era author rerun and current v2 demo results are separate records; runtime declaration envelopes are not an approved same-task improvement budget.

blocking_issues: Full original 16-mouse Fig. 4 recordings and eligible session/location/pair roster are not available in the five-mouse release.
Paper-era default source and native result equivalence are not established for the selected v2 runtime.
The registered greedy two-day probability decoder, finite-value rules and yield guard are benchmark conventions requiring original-paper parity review.
Meaningful AUC effect, uncertainty decision, candidate access and concrete cumulative resource budget remain unfrozen.

legacy.notes: Preserve the original native-paired source, all five-mouse materials and existing graders as calibration/extension evidence. Its strict equal-mouse proxy gain cannot admit a source-paper win.
